name: e08_extreme_waves
frozen: 2026-11-04, before any e08 run (development probe or evaluation)
purpose: PR course final project: does the MLE-learned process noise Q still beat the hand-tuned drone tracker when waves and weather are more extreme than anything run before, and how does it compare with raw YOLO?
hypothesis: H1 (confirmatory): learned Q (x10, learned on e07 data only) tracks more frames with IoU>=0.5 than the hand-tuned tracker, per sequence, Wilcoxon signed-rank, two-sided. No directional hypothesis versus YOLO only: that comparison is descriptive and every result is reported.

replay_arms.yolo_only: newest YOLO leader box, 1 step late
replay_arms.learned_Q: same, process noise x10 (MLE on e07 training folds; no refit on e08)

metrics: per camera sequence: % frames with IoU>=0.5 against the simulator leader box; same on the fastest 20% vertical-motion frames; t>=0 only via all frames with ground truth
inclusion_rule: A development probe (seed 1701, cases X2 and X3, arm on_pv) checks only that the run completes and the leader ground-truth box is visible in >=50% of front-camera frames. A case failing this is dropped BEFORE evaluation and reported as dropped. Detection or tracking results are never used to keep or drop a case.
